title: Polynomial-size deterministic isolation family for bounded-size vector sets
claims: SparseCoordinateSeparation checks the bound of at most |S|-1 separating coordinates.
SparseCoordinateIsolationFamily gives exactly (1 + 2n)^c optional-test patterns and proves that every element of a set of size at most c+1 is isolated by a pattern.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against pinned definitions.
